verdict.rationale: Automating month-end close is a fair question for a payroll and finance platform with accounting integrations, but the pack shows no Gusto AI automation for closing books. The General Ledger report API, the developer-facing MCP server and the agent-friendly CLI are developer building blocks. The Money Dashboard is a cash-flow view, not an AI close workflow.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can use AI automations to close my books faster each month
